instruction: Perform 12-lead ECG within 10 minutes and establish IV access
Stat High-Sensitivity Troponin I, CBC, CMP, and Chest X-Ray
Do NOT discharge to outpatient clinic or delay ECG for waiting room intake
Activate Code Stroke team and obtain Stat Non-Contrast Head CT
Do NOT administer oral fluids, food, or antiplatelets before CT rules out hemorrhage
Prepare IM Epinephrine 0.3-0.5 mg, high-flow oxygen, and airway kit
Initiate droplet isolation, blood cultures, and urgent empiric IV antibiotics
Start Sepsis-1 bundle: Lactate, blood cultures, IV crystalloids, broad-spectrum antibiotics
Check capillary glucose/ketones, ABG/VBG, and initiate IV Normal Saline resuscitation
Repeat bilateral BP check, fundoscopy, ECG, renal panel, and troponin
Administer nebulized SABA + ipratropium and continuous pulse oximetry
NPO status, CBC, CRP, surgical consultation, and abdominal ultrasound/CT
Do NOT give oral analgesics or laxatives prior to surgical evaluation
Obtain Chest X-Ray, pulse oximetry, and sputum/blood cultures if febrile
Oral or IV rehydration therapy and serum electrolytes assessment
Quiet dark room evaluation and targeted non-opioid migraine protocol
Outpatient supportive care guidance, hydration, and return-precaution instructions
